Create `internal/providers/linuxssh/containers_integration_test.go`:

```go
//go:build integration

package linuxssh

import (
	"bufio"
	"context"
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"crypto/rand"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"github.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-go"
	tcexec "github.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-go/exec"
	"github.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-go/wait"
	"golang.org/x/crypto/ssh"

	"alice/internal/platform/clock"
	"alice/internal/providers"
	"alice/internal/providers/linuxssh/helperproto"
)

// Real OpenSSH servers (spec §22.3, §26.5): Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12 and Rocky 9 images from
// test/images/sshd, prepared with the exact setup script Alice generates and the real static
// alice-helper, reached through the production Dialer, Pool and Provider. Select distributions
// with ALICE_SSH_IMAGES (default: all three), for example
//
//	ALICE_SSH_IMAGES=ubuntu22 go test -count=1 -tags integration -run TestRealOpenSSH ./internal/providers/linuxssh/

var distros = map[string]string{"ubuntu22": "ubuntu", "debian12": "debian", "rocky9": "rocky"} // image -> os-release ID

func selectedDistros(t *testing.T) []string {
	t.Helper()
	sel := os.Getenv("ALICE_SSH_IMAGES")
	if sel == "" {
		sel = "ubuntu22,debian12,rocky9"
	}
	var out []string
	for _, name := range strings.Split(sel, ",") {
		name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
		if _, ok := distros[name]; !ok {
			t.Fatalf("ALICE_SSH_IMAGES: unknown image %q (known: ubuntu22, debian12, rocky9)", name)
		}
		out = append(out, name)
	}
	sort.Strings(out)
	return out
}

var (
	helperOnce sync.Once
	helperBin  string
	helperErr  error
)

// buildHelper compiles the static alice-helper for the container's architecture, once per run.
func buildHelper(t *testing.T) string {
	t.Helper()
	helperOnce.Do(func() {
		dir, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "alice-helper-")
		if err != nil {
			helperErr = err
			return
		}
		helperBin = filepath.Join(dir, "alice-helper")
		cmd := exec.Command("go", "build", "-trimpath", "-o", helperBin, "./cmd/alice-helper")
		cmd.Dir = filepath.Join("..", "..", "..")
		cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "CGO_ENABLED=0", "GOOS=linux", "GOARCH="+runtime.GOARCH)
		if out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
			helperErr = errors.New("build alice-helper: " + string(out))
		}
	})
	require.NoError(t, helperErr)
	return helperBin
}

// memHostKeys is an in-memory host-key store with an explicit Pin (the administrator's confirmation).
type memHostKeys struct {
	mu       sync.Mutex
	pinned   map[uuid.UUID]providers.HostKey
	observed []observation
}

type observation struct {
	key     providers.HostKey
	changed bool
}

func newMemHostKeys() *memHostKeys { return &memHostKeys{pinned: map[uuid.UUID]providers.HostKey{}} }

func (m *memHostKeys) Pinned(_ context.Context, id uuid.UUID) (providers.HostKey, error) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	k, ok := m.pinned[id]
	if !ok {
		return providers.HostKey{}, providers.ErrNoPinnedKey
	}
	return k, nil
}

func (m *memHostKeys) Observed(_ context.Context, _ uuid.UUID, key providers.HostKey, changed bool) error {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	m.observed = append(m.observed, observation{key: key, changed: changed})
	return nil
}

func (m *memHostKeys) Pin(id uuid.UUID, k providers.HostKey) {
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	m.pinned[id] = k
}

func (m *memHostKeys) last(t *testing.T) observation {
	t.Helper()
	m.mu.Lock()
	defer m.mu.Unlock()
	require.NotEmpty(t, m.observed, "the presented host key was recorded")
	return m.observed[len(m.observed)-1]
}

type signerSource struct{ s ssh.Signer }

func (c signerSource) SSHSigner(context.Context) (ssh.Signer, func(), error) { return c.s, func() {}, nil }

type noSteps struct{}

func (noSteps) Step(string, providers.StepStatus, map[string]string) {}

// realHost is one running container prepared with the setup script.
type realHost struct {
	t        *testing.T
	ctr      testcontainers.Container
	target   uuid.UUID
	cfg      Config
	keys     *memHostKeys
	signer   ssh.Signer
	platform string // the platform key's fingerprint
	osID     string
}

func startRealHost(t *testing.T, image string) *realHost {
	t.Helper()
	ctx := context.Background()
	helper := buildHelper(t)
	ctr, err := testcontainers.GenericContainer(ctx, testcontainers.GenericContainerRequest{
		ContainerRequest: testcontainers.ContainerRequest{
			FromDockerfile: testcontainers.FromDockerfile{
				Context:    filepath.Join("..", "..", "..", "test", "images", "sshd"),
				Dockerfile: image + ".Dockerfile",
				Repo:       "alice-test/sshd-" + image,
				Tag:        "phase3",
				KeepImage:  true,
			},
			ExposedPorts: []string{"22/tcp"},
			WaitingFor:   wait.ForListeningPort("22/tcp").WithStartupTimeout(2 * time.Minute),
		},
		Started: true,
	})
	testcontainers.CleanupContainer(t, ctr)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	_, priv, err := ed25519.GenerateKey(rand.Reader)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	signer, err := ssh.NewSignerFromKey(priv)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	pub := strings.TrimSpace(string(ssh.MarshalAuthorizedKey(signer.PublicKey())))
	script, err := SetupScript("linux", AuthorizedKeysLine(pub, ""))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, ctr.CopyFileToContainer(ctx, helper, "/root/bundle/alice-helper", 0o755))
	require.NoError(t, ctr.CopyToContainer(ctx, []byte(script), "/root/bundle/setup.sh", 0o700))

	endpoint, err := ctr.PortEndpoint(ctx, "22/tcp", "")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	host, portText, err := net.SplitHostPort(endpoint)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	port, err := strconv.Atoi(portText)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	h := &realHost{t: t, ctr: ctr, target: uuid.New(), cfg: Config{Host: host, Port: port, Username: ServiceUser},
		keys: newMemHostKeys(), signer: signer, platform: ssh.FingerprintSHA256(signer.PublicKey()), osID: distros[image]}
	h.mustExec("sh", "-c", "cd /root/bundle && sh ./setup.sh")
	return h
}

// exec runs a command in the container (as root unless opts say otherwise) and returns the
// exit code and the combined output.
func (h *realHost) exec(cmd []string, opts ...tcexec.ProcessOption) (int, string) {
	h.t.Helper()
	code, r, err := h.ctr.Exec(context.Background(), cmd, append(opts, tcexec.Multiplexed())...)
	require.NoError(h.t, err)
	out, err := io.ReadAll(r)
	require.NoError(h.t, err)
	return code, string(out)
}

func (h *realHost) mustExec(cmd ...string) string {
	h.t.Helper()
	code, out := h.exec(cmd)
	require.Zero(h.t, code, "%v: %s", cmd, out)
	return out
}

// hostFingerprint is what an administrator sees when running the verification command on the server.
func (h *realHost) hostFingerprint() string {
	return strings.Fields(h.mustExec("ssh-keygen", "-lf", "/etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub"))[1]
}

// accepted counts successful public-key logins in sshd's log (sshd -D -e logs to stderr).
func (h *realHost) accepted() int {
	h.t.Helper()
	rc, err := h.ctr.Logs(context.Background())
	require.NoError(h.t, err)
	defer func() { _ = rc.Close() }()
	raw, err := io.ReadAll(rc)
	require.NoError(h.t, err)
	return strings.Count(string(raw), "Accepted publickey")
}

func (h *realHost) newProvider() (*Provider, *Pool) {
	pool := NewPool(&Dialer{Clock: clock.Real{}, HostKeys: h.keys}, MaxConnections, MaxConnectionsPerTarget, IdleTimeout)
	h.t.Cleanup(pool.Close)
	return New(Options{Pool: pool}), pool
}

func (h *realHost) ref() providers.TargetRef {
	return providers.TargetRef{ID: h.target, Name: "real", Kind: providers.KindLinuxSSH,
		Config: providers.TargetConfig{"host": h.cfg.Host, "port": h.cfg.Port, "username": h.cfg.Username}}
}

func (h *realHost) open(p *Provider) (providers.Session, error) {
	return p.Open(context.Background(), h.ref(), signerSource{h.signer},
		providers.Env{Clock: clock.Real{}, HostKeys: h.keys})
}

func (h *realHost) mustOpen(p *Provider) providers.Session {
	h.t.Helper()
	s, err := h.open(p)
	require.NoError(h.t, err)
	h.t.Cleanup(func() { _ = s.Close() })
	return s
}

func requireCode(t *testing.T, err error, code string) *providers.Error {
	t.Helper()
	var pe *providers.Error
	require.ErrorAs(t, err, &pe)
	require.Equal(t, code, pe.Code)
	return pe
}

type keyRow struct{ user, fingerprint, comment string }

// fixtureKeys reads the keys the inventory must list from the image.
func (h *realHost) fixtureKeys() []keyRow {
	var rows []keyRow
	sc := bufio.NewScanner(strings.NewReader(h.mustExec("cat", "/root/fixture-keys.tsv")))
	for sc.Scan() {
		f := strings.Split(sc.Text(), "\t")
		require.Len(h.t, f, 3, sc.Text())
		rows = append(rows, keyRow{f[0], f[1], f[2]})
	}
	return rows
}

func sortRows(rows []keyRow) []keyRow {
	sort.Slice(rows, func(i, j int) bool {
		return rows[i].user+rows[i].fingerprint < rows[j].user+rows[j].fingerprint
	})
	return rows
}

func (h *realHost) sha(path string) string {
	return strings.Fields(h.mustExec("sha256sum", path))[0]
}

func TestRealOpenSSH(t *testing.T) {
	for _, image := range selectedDistros(t) {
		t.Run(image, func(t *testing.T) {
			h := startRealHost(t, image)
			prov, pool := h.newProvider()
			ctx := context.Background()

			// F-30: the first connection stops at the key exchange; the presented key is the
			// server's real key; no login happened.
			before := h.accepted()
			_, err := h.open(prov)
			requireCode(t, err, "target.host_key_unconfirmed")
			first := h.keys.last(t)
			assert.False(t, first.changed)
			assert.Equal(t, h.hostFingerprint(), first.key.Fingerprint)
			assert.Equal(t, "ssh-ed25519", first.key.Type)
			assert.Equal(t, before, h.accepted(), "no authentication before the fingerprint is confirmed")

			// The administrator confirms; the connection test reports the helper and the OS.
			h.keys.Pin(h.target, first.key)
			sess := h.mustOpen(prov)
			report, err := sess.TestConnection(ctx)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			assert.Equal(t, helperproto.Protocol, report.HelperProtocol)
			assert.Equal(t, h.osID, report.OS.ID)
			assert.Equal(t, first.key.Fingerprint, report.HostKey.Fingerprint)

			// Exit criterion "inventory matches the seeded fixtures exactly": every fixture key with
			// its user, plus Alice's own key for alice-svc; nothing for noshell or linky.
			res, err := sess.Discover(ctx, providers.DiscoverRequest{SSHKeys: true})
			require.NoError(t, err)
			want := append(h.fixtureKeys(), keyRow{ServiceUser, h.platform, ""})
			var got []keyRow
			for _, k := range res.SSHKeys {
				got = append(got, keyRow{k.OSUser, k.Fingerprint, k.Comment})
				assert.NotContains(t, k.Flags, providers.FlagRootWithoutFrom, "the root key carries from=")
				if k.Comment == "ci@build" {
					assert.Equal(t, 3072, k.Bits)
					assert.NotContains(t, k.Flags, providers.FlagWeak)
				}
			}
			assert.Equal(t, sortRows(want), sortRows(got))
			assert.True(t, res.SSHD.Read)
			assert.False(t, res.SSHD.KeysManagedElsewhere)
			assert.NotEmpty(t, res.HostKeys)
			linky := false
			for _, w := range res.Warnings {
				for _, v := range w.Params {
					linky = linky || strings.Contains(v, "/home/linky")
				}
			}
			assert.True(t, linky, "the symlinked file of linky is reported, not read: %+v", res.Warnings)

			// The sudoers profile allows only the helper's linux subcommands.
			code, out := h.exec([]string{"sudo", "-n", "/bin/cat", "/etc/shadow"}, tcexec.WithUser(ServiceUser))
			assert.NotZero(t, code)
			assert.NotContains(t, out, "root:")
			code, _ = h.exec([]string{"sudo", "-n", helperproto.HelperPath, "nginx-dump"}, tcexec.WithUser(ServiceUser))
			assert.NotZero(t, code, "the linux profile has no nginx subcommands")

			// A-13: the helper refuses a path outside the candidate files, through the real sudo.
			conn, release, err := pool.Acquire(ctx, h.target, h.cfg, signerSource{h.signer})
			require.NoError(t, err)
			cmd, err := CmdAuthKeysRead("/etc/shadow")
			require.NoError(t, err)
			r, err := conn.Run(ctx, cmd)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			_, err = DecodeHelper[helperproto.AuthKeysReadResponse](r, helperproto.SubAuthKeysRead)
			pe := requireCode(t, err, "ssh.helper_refused")
			assert.Equal(t, helperproto.CodePathNotAllowed, pe.Params["helper_code"])
			assert.NotContains(t, string(r.Stdout), "root:")
			release(true)

			// F-36: Alice's own key is never removed, and nothing is written.
			ownFile := "/var/lib/alice-svc/.ssh/authorized_keys"
			ownSHA := h.sha(ownFile)
			_, err = sess.RemoveAuthorizedKey(ctx, providers.AuthKeyChange{OperationID: uuid.New(), OSUser: ServiceUser,
				FilePath: ownFile, Fingerprint: h.platform, ProtectedFingerprints: []string{h.platform}}, noSteps{})
			requireCode(t, err, "sshkey.own_key_protected")
			assert.Equal(t, ownSHA, h.sha(ownFile))

			// F-37: adding to a file without a trailing newline starts a new line.
			_, priv, err := ed25519.GenerateKey(rand.Reader)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			extra, err := ssh.NewSignerFromKey(priv)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			line := strings.TrimSpace(string(ssh.MarshalAuthorizedKey(extra.PublicKey()))) + " added@alice"
			nonl := "/home/nonl/.ssh/authorized_keys"
			oldNonl := h.mustExec("cat", nonl)
			res2, err := sess.AddAuthorizedKey(ctx, providers.AuthKeyChange{OperationID: uuid.New(), OSUser: "nonl",
				FilePath: nonl, Line: line}, noSteps{})
			require.NoError(t, err)
			assert.True(t, res2.Changed)
			assert.True(t, res2.Verified)
			assert.Equal(t, oldNonl+"\n"+line+"\n", h.mustExec("cat", nonl))
			assert.Equal(t, "nonl:nonl 600", strings.TrimSpace(h.mustExec("stat", "-c", "%U:%G %a", nonl)), "owner and mode kept")

			// F-38: the file changes between Alice's read and write; the helper refuses the stale
			// write, Alice reads again and keeps the concurrent line.
			deployFile := "/home/deploy/.ssh/authorized_keys"
			var raced sync.Once
			beforeAuthKeysWrite = func(path string) {
				raced.Do(func() { h.mustExec("sh", "-c", "echo '# added by another admin' >> "+path) })
			}
			t.Cleanup(func() { beforeAuthKeysWrite = nil })
			var ciFP string
			for _, k := range h.fixtureKeys() {
				if k.comment == "ci@build" {
					ciFP = k.fingerprint
				}
			}
			res3, err := sess.RemoveAuthorizedKey(ctx, providers.AuthKeyChange{OperationID: uuid.New(), OSUser: "deploy",
				FilePath: deployFile, Fingerprint: ciFP, ProtectedFingerprints: []string{h.platform}}, noSteps{})
			beforeAuthKeysWrite = nil
			require.NoError(t, err)
			assert.Equal(t, 1, res3.Removed)
			after := h.mustExec("cat", deployFile)
			assert.Contains(t, after, "# added by another admin", "the concurrent change survived")
			assert.Contains(t, after, "deploy@laptop", "the other key is untouched")
			assert.NotContains(t, after, "ci@build")

			// F-35: with AuthorizedKeysCommand the keys are still listed but not managed.
			h.mustExec("sh", "-c", "printf 'AuthorizedKeysCommand /bin/true\\nAuthorizedKeysCommandUser nobody\\n' >> /etc/ssh/sshd_config && sshd -t && pkill -HUP -o -x sshd")
			res4, err := sess.Discover(ctx, providers.DiscoverRequest{SSHKeys: true})
			require.NoError(t, err)
			assert.True(t, res4.SSHD.KeysManagedElsewhere)
			assert.NotEmpty(t, res4.SSHKeys)
			_, err = sess.RemoveAuthorizedKey(ctx, providers.AuthKeyChange{OperationID: uuid.New(), OSUser: "deploy",
				FilePath: deployFile, Fingerprint: h.fixtureKeys()[0].fingerprint, ProtectedFingerprints: []string{h.platform}}, noSteps{})
			requireCode(t, err, "ssh.keys_managed_elsewhere")
			require.NoError(t, sess.Close())

			// F-31: new host keys; a new connection stops at the key exchange with the new key
			// recorded as changed, and no login reaches the server.
			oldFP := first.key.Fingerprint
			h.mustExec("sh", "-c", "rm -f /etc/ssh/ssh_host_* && ssh-keygen -A >/dev/null && pkill -HUP -o -x sshd")
			require.Eventually(t, func() bool { return h.hostFingerprint() != oldFP }, 10*time.Second, 100*time.Millisecond)
			require.Eventually(t, func() bool {
				c, err := net.DialTimeout("tcp", net.JoinHostPort(h.cfg.Host, strconv.Itoa(h.cfg.Port)), time.Second)
				if err == nil {
					_ = c.Close()
				}
				return err == nil
			}, 10*time.Second, 100*time.Millisecond)
			before = h.accepted()
			fresh, _ := h.newProvider() // a new pool: an idle connection opened before the rotation proves nothing
			_, err = h.open(fresh)
			requireCode(t, err, "target.host_key_changed")
			changed := h.keys.last(t)
			assert.True(t, changed.changed)
			assert.Equal(t, h.hostFingerprint(), changed.key.Fingerprint)
			assert.NotEqual(t, oldFP, changed.key.Fingerprint)
			assert.Equal(t, before, h.accepted(), "no authentication with a changed host key")
		})
	}
}
```

```ts
// Phase 3: servers (targets), host keys, SSH key inventory, jobs (api/openapi.yaml).

export type TargetStatus = 'pending_host_key' | 'checking' | 'ok' | 'unreachable' | 'host_key_changed' | 'auth_failed' | 'disabled';
export type TargetType = 'linux' | 'nginx' | 'azure_key_vault';

// Warning is a stable code (translated as warnings.<code>) and its parameters.
export interface Warning {
  code: string;
  params: Record<string, string>;
}

export interface OSRelease {
  id: string;
  version_id: string;
  pretty_name: string;
}

export interface DiscoveredHostKey {
  key_type: string;
  bits: number;
  fingerprint: string;
  weak: boolean;
}

export interface UnreadableLine {
  os_user: string;
  file_path: string;
  line_no: number;
}

export interface TargetFacts {
  os: OSRelease;
  helper_version: string;
  helper_protocol: number;
  sshd: Record<string, unknown> | null;
  host_keys: DiscoveredHostKey[];
  warnings: Warning[];
  unreadable: UnreadableLine[];
}

export interface Target {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: TargetType;
  host: string;
  port: number;
  username: string;
  status: TargetStatus;
  last_error: { code: string; reason: string } | null;
  last_success_at: string | null;
  last_discovery_at: string | null;
  discovery_interval_hours: number;
  keys_managed_elsewhere: boolean;
  capabilities: string[];
  facts: TargetFacts;
  version: number;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
}

export interface TargetCreateRequest {
  name: string;
  type: 'linux';
  host: string;
  port: number;
  username: string;
}

export interface JobAccepted {
  job_id: string;
  status_url: string;
}

export interface TargetCreated extends JobAccepted {
  target: Target;
}

export type HostKeyStatus = 'observed' | 'pinned' | 'superseded' | 'rejected';

export interface HostKey {
  id: string;
  key_type: string;
  fingerprint: string;
  status: HostKeyStatus;
  observed_at: string;
  confirmed_at: string | null;
  confirmed_by_name: string;
  superseded_at: string | null;
  verify_command: string;
}

export type KeyFlag = 'weak' | 'command' | 'root_without_from' | 'duplicate' | 'cert_authority' | 'security_key';

export interface KeyLocation {
  id: string;
  ssh_key_id: string;
  fingerprint: string;
  key_type: string;
  target_id: string;
  target_name: string;
  os_user: string;
  file_path: string;
  line_no: number;
  options: string;
  comment: string;
  flags: KeyFlag[];
  first_seen_at: string;
  last_seen_at: string;
  missing_since: string | null;
  removed_at: string | null;
  is_alice_connection_key: boolean;
}

export interface SSHKey {
  id: string;
  fingerprint: string;
  key_type: string;
  bits: number;
  public_key: string;
  managed: boolean;
  is_platform_key: boolean;
  weak: boolean;
  comment: string;
  location_count: number;
  target_count: number;
  first_seen_at: string;
  locations?: KeyLocation[];
}

export interface SSHKeyPage {
  items: SSHKey[];
  next_cursor: string | null;
}

export interface SSHKeyQuery {
  target_id?: string;
  os_user?: string;
  q?: string;
  flag?: KeyFlag | '';
  missing?: boolean;
  cursor?: string | null;
  limit?: number;
}

export interface SetupSnippet {
  sudoers: string;
  script: string;
}

export interface PlatformKeyInfo {
  public_key: string;
  fingerprint: string;
  authorized_keys_line: string;
  helper_path: string;
  helper_protocol: number;
  profiles: { linux: SetupSnippet; nginx: SetupSnippet };
}

export type JobStatus = 'queued' | 'running' | 'succeeded' | 'failed' | 'cancelled' | 'dead' | 'blocked_license';

export interface JobError {
  code: string;
  reason: string;
  params?: Record<string, string>;
}

export interface Job {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  kind: 'user' | 'scheduled' | 'system';
  status: JobStatus;
  target_id: string | null;
  attempts: number;
  max_attempts: number;
  error: JobError | null;
  result: Record<string, unknown>;
  created_at: string;
  run_at: string;
  started_at: string | null;
  finished_at: string | null;
}

export interface JobPage {
  items: Job[];
  next_cursor: string | null;
}

export interface JobQuery {
  status?: JobStatus;
  target_id?: string;
  cursor?: string | null;
}
```

```ts
// Servers (targets) and host keys
const enc = encodeURIComponent;

export const listTargets = () => apiFetch<{ items: Target[]; next_cursor: string | null }>(`${v1}/targets`);

export const getTarget = (id: string) => apiFetch<Target>(`${v1}/targets/${enc(id)}`);

export const createTarget = (req: TargetCreateRequest) =>
  apiFetch<TargetCreated>(`${v1}/targets`, { method: 'POST', body: req });

export const deleteTarget = (id: string) => apiFetch<void>(`${v1}/targets/${enc(id)}`, { method: 'DELETE' });

export const testTarget = (id: string) =>
  apiFetch<JobAccepted>(`${v1}/targets/${enc(id)}/actions/test`, { method: 'POST' });

export const discoverTarget = (id: string) =>
  apiFetch<JobAccepted>(`${v1}/targets/${enc(id)}/actions/discover`, { method: 'POST' });

export const listHostKeys = (targetId: string) => apiFetch<{ items: HostKey[] }>(`${v1}/targets/${enc(targetId)}/host-keys`);

export const confirmHostKey = (targetId: string, keyId: string, fingerprint: string) =>
  apiFetch<JobAccepted>(`${v1}/targets/${enc(targetId)}/host-keys/${enc(keyId)}/actions/confirm`, {
    method: 'POST',
    body: { fingerprint },
  });

export const repinHostKey = (targetId: string, keyId: string, fingerprint: string, reason: string) =>
  apiFetch<JobAccepted>(`${v1}/targets/${enc(targetId)}/host-keys/${enc(keyId)}/actions/repin`, {
    method: 'POST',
    body: { fingerprint, reason },
  });

export const listTargetKeys = (targetId: string, missing = false) =>
  apiFetch<{ items: KeyLocation[] }>(`${v1}/targets/${enc(targetId)}/ssh-keys${missing ? '?missing=true' : ''}`);

// SSH keys
export function listSSHKeys(q: SSHKeyQuery = {}): Promise<SSHKeyPage> {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if (q.target_id) params.set('target_id', q.target_id);
  if (q.os_user) params.set('os_user', q.os_user);
  if (q.q) params.set('q', q.q);
  if (q.flag) params.set('flag', q.flag);
  if (q.missing) params.set('missing', 'true');
  if (q.cursor) params.set('cursor', q.cursor);
  if (q.limit) params.set('limit', String(q.limit));
  const qs = params.toString();
  return apiFetch<SSHKeyPage>(`${v1}/ssh-keys${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}`);
}

export const getSSHKey = (id: string) => apiFetch<SSHKey>(`${v1}/ssh-keys/${enc(id)}`);

export const getPlatformKey = () => apiFetch<PlatformKeyInfo>(`${v1}/ssh-keys/platform-key`);

export const removeKeyLocation = (id: string, confirmLastRootKey = false) =>
  apiFetch<JobAccepted>(`${v1}/ssh-keys/locations/${enc(id)}/actions/remove`, {
    method: 'POST',
    body: { confirm_last_root_key: confirmLastRootKey },
  });

// Jobs
export function listJobs(q: JobQuery = {}): Promise<JobPage> {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if (q.status) params.set('status', q.status);
  if (q.target_id) params.set('target_id', q.target_id);
  if (q.cursor) params.set('cursor', q.cursor);
  const qs = params.toString();
  return apiFetch<JobPage>(`${v1}/jobs${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}`);
}

export const getJob = (id: string) => apiFetch<Job>(`${v1}/jobs/${enc(id)}`);

export const confirmJob = (id: string) => apiFetch<Job>(`${v1}/jobs/${enc(id)}/actions/confirm`, { method: 'POST' });

export const discardJob = (id: string) => apiFetch<Job>(`${v1}/jobs/${enc(id)}/actions/discard`, { method: 'POST' });
```

```ts
import { http, HttpResponse } from 'msw';
import { jobFixture } from '../test/fixtures';
import { server } from '../test/server';
import { isTerminal, JobTimeoutError, waitForJob } from './jobs';

describe('waitForJob', () => {
  it('polls until the job has finished', async () => {
    let calls = 0;
    server.use(
      http.get('/api/v1/jobs/:id', ({ params }) => {
        calls += 1;
        const status = calls < 3 ? 'running' : 'succeeded';
        return HttpResponse.json(jobFixture({ id: String(params.id), status }));
      }),
    );
    const job = await waitForJob('job-1', { intervalMs: 1 });
    expect(job.status).toBe('succeeded');
    expect(job.id).toBe('job-1');
    expect(calls).toBe(3);
  });

  it('treats a job waiting for an administrator as finished for the caller', () => {
    expect(isTerminal('blocked_license')).toBe(true);
    expect(isTerminal('failed')).toBe(true);
    expect(isTerminal('queued')).toBe(false);
    expect(isTerminal('running')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('gives up after the timeout and returns the last state', async () => {
    server.use(http.get('/api/v1/jobs/:id', () => HttpResponse.json(jobFixture({ status: 'running' }))));
    const err = await waitForJob('job-2', { intervalMs: 1, timeoutMs: 5 }).catch((e: unknown) => e);
    expect(err).toBeInstanceOf(JobTimeoutError);
    expect((err as JobTimeoutError).job.status).toBe('running');
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement job polling**

Create `web/src/api/jobs.ts`:

```ts
import { getJob } from './endpoints';
import type { Job, JobStatus } from './types';

// A job in one of these states will not change on its own any more. blocked_license waits for an
// Administrator (R29), so a screen that started it stops waiting and shows that state instead.
const TERMINAL: ReadonlySet<JobStatus> = new Set<JobStatus>(['succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'dead', 'blocked_license']);

export function isTerminal(status: JobStatus): boolean {
  return TERMINAL.has(status);
}

// JobTimeoutError means the job did not finish while the screen waited; job is its last state.
export class JobTimeoutError extends Error {
  readonly job: Job;

  constructor(job: Job) {
    super('job did not finish in time');
    this.name = 'JobTimeoutError';
    this.job = job;
  }
}

function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

// waitForJob polls GET /jobs/{id} until the job has finished. Long operations answer 202 with a
// job ID (spec §9.1); the screens wait here and then refresh what the job changed.
export async function waitForJob(id: string, opts: { intervalMs?: number; timeoutMs?: number } = {}): Promise<Job> {
  const interval = opts.intervalMs ?? 1000;
  const deadline = Date.now() + (opts.timeoutMs ?? 120_000);
  for (;;) {
    const job = await getJob(id);
    if (isTerminal(job.status)) return job;
    if (Date.now() > deadline) throw new JobTimeoutError(job);
    await sleep(interval);
  }
}
```

Expected: PASS (3 tests).

```ts
import type { CSSProperties } from 'react';

// WRAP lets long technical strings (keys, fingerprints, paths, commands) break anywhere, so a
// screen never scrolls sideways at 375 px; the text itself (and what Copy copies) is unchanged.
export const WRAP: CSSProperties = { whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap', overflowWrap: 'anywhere', wordBreak: 'break-word' };
```

```tsx
import { Badge } from '@mantine/core';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import type { TargetStatus } from '../api/types';

// The color is a cue only; the text always names the status.
const COLORS: Record<TargetStatus, string> = {
  ok: 'green',
  checking: 'blue',
  pending_host_key: 'yellow',
  unreachable: 'orange',
  host_key_changed: 'red',
  auth_failed: 'red',
  disabled: 'gray',
};

export function TargetStatusBadge({ status, testId }: { status: TargetStatus; testId?: string }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  // tt="none": no CSS upper-casing of translated text (Turkish dotted/dotless i, spec §10.5).
  return (
    <Badge variant="light" color={COLORS[status] ?? 'gray'} tt="none" data-testid={testId}>
      {t(`enum.targetStatus.${status}`)}
    </Badge>
  );
}
```

Create `web/src/components/JobErrorAlert.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Alert, Text } from '@mantine/core';
import type { i18n as I18n, TFunction } from 'i18next';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import type { JobError } from '../api/types';

// reasonTitle is the one-line text of a stable error reason (errors.<reason>.title); an unknown
// reason gets the generic message, never the raw reason.
export function reasonTitle(t: TFunction, i18n: I18n, reason: string, params: Record<string, string> = {}): string {
  const key = `errors.${reason}.title`;
  return i18n.exists(key) ? t(key, params) : t('ui.unexpectedError');
}

// JobErrorAlert shows why a background job failed: what happened, what to do, and the code.
export function JobErrorAlert({ error }: { error: JobError | null }) {
  const { t, i18n } = useTranslation();
  if (!error) return null;
  const params = error.params ?? {};
  const actionKey = `errors.${error.reason}.action`;
  return (
    <Alert color="red" role="alert" title={reasonTitle(t, i18n, error.reason, params)}>
      {i18n.exists(actionKey) && <Text size="sm">{t(actionKey, params)}</Text>}
      {error.code && (
        <Text size="xs" c="gray.7" mt="xs">
          {t('jobs.errorCode', { code: error.code })}
        </Text>
      )}
    </Alert>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Badge, Group } from '@mantine/core';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import type { KeyLocation } from '../api/types';

// KeyFlags shows "Alice's key" and the findings of the scan (spec §13.3 item 5) as text badges.
export function KeyFlags({ location }: { location: Pick<KeyLocation, 'flags' | 'is_alice_connection_key'> }) {
  const { t, i18n } = useTranslation();
  const flags = location.flags.filter((f) => i18n.exists(`sshKeys.flags.${f}`));
  if (!location.is_alice_connection_key && flags.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <Group gap={4}>
      {location.is_alice_connection_key && (
        <Badge variant="light" color="indigo" tt="none">
          {t('sshKeys.aliceKey')}
        </Badge>
      )}
      {flags.map((f) => (
        <Badge key={f} variant="light" color={f === 'weak' || f === 'root_without_from' ? 'orange' : 'gray'} tt="none">
          {t(`sshKeys.flags.${f}`)}
        </Badge>
      ))}
    </Group>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Button, Code, Group, Stack, Text } from '@mantine/core';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import type { HostKey } from '../api/types';
import { WRAP } from './wrap';

// HostKeyConfirm asks a person to compare the presented fingerprint with the one the server
// shows (TOFU with human confirmation, SEC-080). Nothing is trusted until onYes.
export function HostKeyConfirm({
  host,
  hostKey,
  onYes,
  onNo,
  busy = false,
}: {
  host: string;
  hostKey: HostKey;
  onYes: () => void;
  onNo?: () => void;
  busy?: boolean;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  return (
    <Stack gap="xs">
      <Text size="sm">{t('hostKeys.confirmHelp', { host })}</Text>
      <Text size="sm" fw={600}>
        {t('hostKeys.fingerprintLabel')}
      </Text>
      <Code block data-testid="host-key-fingerprint" style={WRAP}>
        {hostKey.fingerprint}
      </Code>
      <Text size="sm" fw={600}>
        {t('hostKeys.commandLabel')}
      </Text>
      <Code block data-testid="host-key-command" style={WRAP}>
        {hostKey.verify_command}
      </Code>
      {onNo && (
        <Text size="xs" c="gray.7">
          {t('hostKeys.pendingNote')}
        </Text>
      )}
      <Group justify="flex-end">
        {onNo && (
          <Button variant="default" onClick={onNo}>
            {t('hostKeys.no')}
          </Button>
        )}
        <Button onClick={onYes} loading={busy}>
          {t('hostKeys.yes')}
        </Button>
      </Group>
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Button, Card, Code, CopyButton, NativeSelect, Stack, Text, Title } from '@mantine/core';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { getPlatformKey } from '../api/endpoints';
import { PLATFORM_KEY_KEY } from '../api/queryKeys';
import { ErrorAlert } from './ErrorAlert';
import { WRAP } from './wrap';

type Profile = 'linux' | 'nginx';

// PlatformKeyPanel shows Alice's public key and the commands that prepare a server (spec §12.2,
// §18.5 step 7). The public key is not secret; the private key never leaves the secret store.
export function PlatformKeyPanel({ titleOrder = 2 }: { titleOrder?: 2 | 3 }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const key = useQuery({ queryKey: PLATFORM_KEY_KEY, queryFn: getPlatformKey });
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState<Profile>('linux');
  const script = key.data?.profiles[profile].script ?? '';
  return (
    <Card withBorder padding="md">
      <Stack gap="xs">
        <Title order={titleOrder} size="h3">
          {t('targets.prepare.title')}
        </Title>
        <Text size="sm">{t('targets.prepare.help')}</Text>
        <ErrorAlert error={key.error} />
        {key.data && (
          <>
            <Text size="sm" fw={600}>
              {t('targets.prepare.publicKey')}
            </Text>
            <Code block data-testid="platform-public-key" style={WRAP}>
              {key.data.public_key}
            </Code>
            <Text size="sm" fw={600}>
              {t('targets.prepare.fingerprint')}
            </Text>
            <Code data-testid="platform-fingerprint" style={WRAP}>
              {key.data.fingerprint}
            </Code>
            <NativeSelect
              label={t('targets.prepare.profile')}
              value={profile}
              onChange={(e) => setProfile(e.currentTarget.value as Profile)}
              data={[
                { value: 'linux', label: t('targets.prepare.profileLinux') },
                { value: 'nginx', label: t('targets.prepare.profileNginx') },
              ]}
              maw={320}
            />
            <Text size="sm" fw={600}>
              {t('targets.prepare.script')}
            </Text>
            <Code block data-testid="setup-script" style={WRAP}>
              {script}
            </Code>
            <CopyButton value={script}>
              {({ copied, copy }) => (
                <Button size="xs" variant="light" onClick={copy} w="fit-content">
                  {copied ? t('targets.prepare.copied') : t('targets.prepare.copy')}
                </Button>
              )}
            </CopyButton>
          </>
        )}
      </Stack>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

Create `web/src/components/AddServerModal.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Alert, Button, Group, Loader, NumberInput, Stack, Text, TextInput } from '@mantine/core';
import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { confirmHostKey, createTarget, listHostKeys } from '../api/endpoints';
import { JobTimeoutError, waitForJob } from '../api/jobs';
import { TARGETS_KEY } from '../api/queryKeys';
import type { HostKey, Job, JobError, Target } from '../api/types';
import { AppModal } from './AppModal';
import { ErrorAlert } from './ErrorAlert';
import { HostKeyConfirm } from './HostKeyConfirm';
import { JobErrorAlert } from './JobErrorAlert';

type Phase = 'form' | 'working' | 'confirm' | 'failed';

// AddServerModal creates a Linux server, waits for the first connection test and, when the server
// presented a fingerprint nobody confirmed yet, asks the Administrator to compare and confirm it.
// The server counts toward the license as soon as it is created (spec §7.3).
export function AddServerModal({ onClose, onAdded }: { onClose: () => void; onAdded: (target: Target) => void }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const client = useQueryClient();
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [host, setHost] = useState('');
  const [port, setPort] = useState<number | string>(22);
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('alice-svc');
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>('form');
  const [error, setError] = useState<unknown>(null);
  const [jobError, setJobError] = useState<JobError | null>(null);
  const [target, setTarget] = useState<Target | null>(null);
  const [candidate, setCandidate] = useState<HostKey | null>(null);

  const refresh = () => void client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: TARGETS_KEY });

  // settle decides what a finished connection test means for the dialog.
  const settle = async (tgt: Target, job: Job) => {
    if (job.status === 'succeeded') {
      refresh();
      onAdded(tgt);
      return;
    }
    if (job.error?.reason === 'target.host_key_unconfirmed') {
      const keys = await listHostKeys(tgt.id);
      const observed = keys.items.find((k) => k.status === 'observed') ?? null;
      if (observed) {
        setCandidate(observed);
        setPhase('confirm');
        return;
      }
    }
    setJobError(job.error);
    setPhase('failed');
  };

  const run = async (fn: () => Promise<void>, back: Phase) => {
    setError(null);
    setJobError(null);
    setPhase('working');
    try {
      await fn();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e);
      setPhase(back);
    }
  };

  const submit = (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    void run(async () => {
      const res = await createTarget({ name: name.trim(), type: 'linux', host: host.trim(), port: Number(port), username: username.trim() });
      setTarget(res.target);
      refresh();
      await settle(res.target, await waitForJob(res.job_id));
    }, 'form');
  };

  const confirm = () => {
    if (!target || !candidate) return;
    void run(async () => {
      const res = await confirmHostKey(target.id, candidate.id, candidate.fingerprint);
      await settle(target, await waitForJob(res.job_id));
    }, 'confirm');
  };

  const problem =
    error instanceof JobTimeoutError ? (
      <Alert color="yellow" role="status">
        {t('targets.stillWorking')}
      </Alert>
    ) : (
      <ErrorAlert error={error} />
    );

  return (
    <AppModal opened onClose={onClose} title={phase === 'confirm' ? t('hostKeys.confirmTitle') : t('targets.add')} size="lg">
      {phase === 'working' && (
        <Group gap="sm" role="status" aria-live="polite">
          <Loader size="sm" aria-hidden />
          <Text size="sm">{t('targets.connecting')}</Text>
        </Group>
      )}
      {phase === 'form' && (
        <form onSubmit={submit}>
          <Stack gap="sm">
            <TextInput label={t('targets.form.name')} value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.currentTarget.value)} required maxLength={100} data-autofocus />
            <TextInput
              label={t('targets.form.host')}
              description={t('targets.form.hostHelp')}
              value={host}
              onChange={(e) => setHost(e.currentTarget.value)}
              required
              maxLength={253}
              autoComplete="off"
            />
            <NumberInput label={t('targets.form.port')} value={port} onChange={setPort} min={1} max={65535} allowDecimal={false} required />
            <TextInput label={t('targets.form.username')} value={username} onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.currentTarget.value)} required maxLength={32} />
            {problem}
            <Button type="submit">{t('targets.form.submit')}</Button>
          </Stack>
        </form>
      )}
      {phase === 'confirm' && target && candidate && (
        <Stack gap="sm">
          <HostKeyConfirm host={target.host} hostKey={candidate} onYes={confirm} onNo={onClose} />
          {problem}
        </Stack>
      )}
      {phase === 'failed' && (
        <Stack gap="sm">
          <JobErrorAlert error={jobError} />
          <Text size="sm">{t('targets.failedHelp')}</Text>
          <Group justify="flex-end">
            <Button onClick={onClose}>{t('ui.close')}</Button>
          </Group>
        </Stack>
      )}
    </AppModal>
  );
}
```

Create `web/src/components/RemoveKeyDialog.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Button, Checkbox, Code, Group, Loader, Stack, Text } from '@mantine/core';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { isApiError } from '../api/client';
import { removeKeyLocation } from '../api/endpoints';
import { waitForJob } from '../api/jobs';
import type { JobError, KeyLocation } from '../api/types';
import { useAuth } from '../auth/AuthProvider';
import { AppModal } from './AppModal';
import { ErrorAlert } from './ErrorAlert';
import { JobErrorAlert } from './JobErrorAlert';
import { WRAP } from './wrap';

// RemoveKeyDialog removes one key from one authorized_keys file through the sshkey.remove job.
// The server refuses Alice's own key (409 sshkey.own_key_protected, F-36) and, unless an
// Administrator confirms, the last key of root (sshkey.last_root_key); both are explained here.
export function RemoveKeyDialog({ location, onClose, onDone }: { location: KeyLocation; onClose: () => void; onDone: () => void }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { session } = useAuth();
  const admin = session?.user.role === 'admin';
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<unknown>(null);
  const [jobError, setJobError] = useState<JobError | null>(null);
  const [needsRootConfirm, setNeedsRootConfirm] = useState(false);
  const [rootConfirmed, setRootConfirmed] = useState(false);

  const submit = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    setJobError(null);
    try {
      const accepted = await removeKeyLocation(location.id, needsRootConfirm && rootConfirmed);
      const job = await waitForJob(accepted.job_id);
      if (job.status === 'succeeded') {
        onDone();
        return;
      }
      setJobError(job.error);
    } catch (e) {
      if (isApiError(e, 'sshkey.last_root_key') && admin) setNeedsRootConfirm(true);
      setError(e);
    }
    setBusy(false);
  };

  return (
    <AppModal opened onClose={onClose} title={t('sshKeys.removeTitle')}>
      <Stack gap="sm">
        <Text size="sm">{t('sshKeys.removeHelp', { file: location.file_path })}</Text>
        <Text size="sm">{t('sshKeys.removeUser', { user: location.os_user })}</Text>
        <Text size="sm" fw={600}>
          {t('sshKeys.fingerprintLabel')}
        </Text>
        <Code block style={WRAP}>
          {location.fingerprint}
        </Code>
        {busy && (
          <Group gap="sm" role="status" aria-live="polite">
            <Loader size="sm" aria-hidden />
            <Text size="sm">{t('sshKeys.removeQueued')}</Text>
          </Group>
        )}
        {needsRootConfirm && (
          <Checkbox label={t('sshKeys.confirmLastRootKey')} checked={rootConfirmed} onChange={(e) => setRootConfirmed(e.currentTarget.checked)} />
        )}
        <ErrorAlert error={error} />
        <JobErrorAlert error={jobError} />
        <Group justify="flex-end">
          <Button variant="default" onClick={onClose}>
            {t('sshKeys.removeCancel')}
          </Button>
          {/* red 9: white text 5.4:1 (WCAG AA). */}
          <Button color="red.9" loading={busy} disabled={needsRootConfirm && !rootConfirmed} onClick={() => void submit()}>
            {t('sshKeys.removeConfirm')}
          </Button>
        </Group>
      </Stack>
    </AppModal>
  );
}
```

Create `web/src/components/BlockedJobsPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
import { Button, Card, Group, Stack, Table, Text, Title } from '@mantine/core';
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { confirmJob, discardJob, listJobs } from '../api/endpoints';
import { BLOCKED_JOBS_KEY } from '../api/queryKeys';
import type { Job } from '../api/types';
import { formatDateTime } from '../datetime';
import { ErrorAlert } from './ErrorAlert';

// BlockedJobsPanel lists changes that were paused while the license was expired. After a renewal
// they never start on their own: an Administrator runs or discards each one (R29, L-81).
export function BlockedJobsPanel() {
  const { t, i18n } = useTranslation();
  const client = useQueryClient();
  const jobs = useQuery({ queryKey: BLOCKED_JOBS_KEY, queryFn: () => listJobs({ status: 'blocked_license' }) });
  const [error, setError] = useState<unknown>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const typeLabel = (job: Job) => (i18n.exists(`jobs.types.${job.type}`) ? t(`jobs.types.${job.type}`) : job.type);
  const act = async (job: Job, fn: (id: string) => Promise<Job>) => {
    setBusy(job.id);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await fn(job.id);
      await client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: BLOCKED_JOBS_KEY });
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e);
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  };

  if (!jobs.data || jobs.data.items.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <Card withBorder padding="md" data-testid="blocked-jobs">
      <Stack gap="xs">
        <Title order={2} size="h3">
          {t('jobs.blockedTitle')}
        </Title>
        <Text size="sm">{t('jobs.blockedHelp')}</Text>
        <ErrorAlert error={error} />
        <Table.ScrollContainer minWidth={480}>
          <Table>
            <Table.Tbody>
              {jobs.data.items.map((job) => (
                <Table.Tr key={job.id}>
                  <Table.Td>{typeLabel(job)}</Table.Td>
                  <Table.Td>{t('jobs.created', { time: formatDateTime(job.created_at, i18n.language) })}</Table.Td>
                  <Table.Td>
                    <Group gap="xs" wrap="nowrap">
                      <Button size="xs" loading={busy === job.id} onClick={() => void act(job, confirmJob)} aria-label={t('jobs.runNowNamed', { job: typeLabel(job) })}>
                        {t('jobs.runNow')}
                      </Button>
                      <Button size="xs" variant="default" disabled={busy === job.id} onClick={() => void act(job, discardJob)} aria-label={t('jobs.discardNamed', { job: typeLabel(job) })}>
                        {t('jobs.discard')}
                      </Button>
                    </Group>
                  </Table.Td>
                </Table.Tr>
              ))}
            </Table.Tbody>
          </Table>
        </Table.ScrollContainer>
      </Stack>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Anchor, Button, Code, Group, Stack, Table, Text, Title } from '@mantine/core';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router';
import { listTargets } from '../api/endpoints';
import { TARGETS_KEY } from '../api/queryKeys';
import { useAuth } from '../auth/AuthProvider';
import { AddServerModal } from '../components/AddServerModal';
import { BlockedJobsPanel } from '../components/BlockedJobsPanel';
import { ErrorAlert } from '../components/ErrorAlert';
import { reasonTitle } from '../components/JobErrorAlert';
import { PlatformKeyPanel } from '../components/PlatformKeyPanel';
import { TargetStatusBadge } from '../components/TargetStatusBadge';
import { WRAP } from '../components/wrap';

// TargetsPage lists the managed servers for every role (metadata only, never credentials, R3).
// Administrators also get "Add server", the preparation commands and the paused changes.
export function TargetsPage() {
  const { t, i18n } = useTranslation();
  const { session } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const admin = session?.user.role === 'admin';
  const targets = useQuery({ queryKey: TARGETS_KEY, queryFn: listTargets });
  const [adding, setAdding] = useState(false);

  return (
    <Stack gap="md">
      <Group justify="space-between">
        <Title order={1}>{t('targets.title')}</Title>
        {admin && <Button onClick={() => setAdding(true)}>{t('targets.add')}</Button>}
      </Group>
      <ErrorAlert error={targets.error} />
      {targets.isSuccess && targets.data.items.length === 0 && <Text c="gray.7">{t('targets.empty')}</Text>}
      {targets.isSuccess && targets.data.items.length > 0 && (
        <Table.ScrollContainer minWidth={640}>
          <Table striped data-testid="targets-table">
            <Table.Thead>
              <Table.Tr>
                <Table.Th>{t('targets.columns.name')}</Table.Th>
                <Table.Th>{t('targets.columns.address')}</Table.Th>
                <Table.Th>{t('targets.columns.status')}</Table.Th>
                <Table.Th>{t('targets.columns.problem')}</Table.Th>
              </Table.Tr>
            </Table.Thead>
            <Table.Tbody>
              {targets.data.items.map((tg) => (
                <Table.Tr key={tg.id}>
                  <Table.Td>
                    <Anchor component={Link} to={`/servers/${tg.id}`}>
                      {tg.name}
                    </Anchor>
                  </Table.Td>
                  <Table.Td>
                    <Code style={WRAP}>{`${tg.host}:${tg.port}`}</Code>
                  </Table.Td>
                  <Table.Td>
                    <TargetStatusBadge status={tg.status} />
                  </Table.Td>
                  <Table.Td>{tg.last_error ? reasonTitle(t, i18n, tg.last_error.reason) : ''}</Table.Td>
                </Table.Tr>
              ))}
            </Table.Tbody>
          </Table>
        </Table.ScrollContainer>
      )}
      {admin && <BlockedJobsPanel />}
      {admin && <PlatformKeyPanel />}
      {adding && (
        <AddServerModal
          onClose={() => setAdding(false)}
          onAdded={(tg) => {
            setAdding(false);
            navigate(`/servers/${tg.id}`, { state: { added: true } });
          }}
        />
      )}
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Alert, Button, Card, Code, Group, Loader, Stack, Table, Text, Textarea, Title } from '@mantine/core';
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { useLocation, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router';
import { confirmHostKey, deleteTarget, discoverTarget, getTarget, listHostKeys, listTargetKeys, repinHostKey, testTarget } from '../api/endpoints';
import { JobTimeoutError, waitForJob } from '../api/jobs';
import { TARGETS_KEY, targetKey } from '../api/queryKeys';
import type { HostKey, JobAccepted, JobError, KeyLocation, Target } from '../api/types';
import { useAuth } from '../auth/AuthProvider';
import { PageLoader } from '../auth/guards';
import { AppModal } from '../components/AppModal';
import { ErrorAlert } from '../components/ErrorAlert';
import { HostKeyConfirm } from '../components/HostKeyConfirm';
import { JobErrorAlert } from '../components/JobErrorAlert';
import { KeyFlags } from '../components/KeyFlags';
import { RemoveKeyDialog } from '../components/RemoveKeyDialog';
import { useStepUp } from '../components/StepUpProvider';
import { TargetStatusBadge } from '../components/TargetStatusBadge';
import { WRAP } from '../components/wrap';
import { formatDateTime } from '../datetime';

// TargetDetailPage is one server: its status and facts, the actions Operators and Administrators
// may run, the host-key review after a changed identity (Administrators, step-up, SEC-080), and
// the SSH keys found on it.
export function TargetDetailPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { id = '' } = useParams();
  const { session } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const client = useQueryClient();
  const role = session?.user.role;
  const admin = role === 'admin';
  const canOperate = role === 'admin' || role === 'operator';

  const target = useQuery({
    queryKey: targetKey(id),
    queryFn: () => getTarget(id),
    // Follow a server that is still being checked or scanned.
    refetchInterval: (q) => (q.state.data && (q.state.data.status === 'checking' || !q.state.data.last_discovery_at) ? 3000 : false),
  });
  const hostKeys = useQuery({ queryKey: [...targetKey(id), 'host-keys'], queryFn: () => listHostKeys(id) });
  const keys = useQuery({
    queryKey: [...targetKey(id), 'ssh-keys', target.data?.last_discovery_at ?? null],
    queryFn: () => listTargetKeys(id),
    enabled: target.isSuccess,
  });

  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<unknown>(null);
  const [jobError, setJobError] = useState<JobError | null>(null);
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);
  const [repinning, setRepinning] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);
  const [removing, setRemoving] = useState<KeyLocation | null>(null);

  const refresh = () => client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: TARGETS_KEY });

  // runJob starts a background job, waits for it and refreshes everything it may have changed.
  const runJob = async (start: () => Promise<JobAccepted>) => {
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    setJobError(null);
    setDone(false);
    try {
      const job = await waitForJob((await start()).job_id);
      if (job.status === 'succeeded') setDone(true);
      else setJobError(job.error);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
      await refresh();
    }
  };

  if (target.isPending) return <PageLoader />;
  if (target.isError || !target.data) return <ErrorAlert error={target.error} />;
  const tg = target.data;
  const pinned = hostKeys.data?.items.find((k) => k.status === 'pinned') ?? null;
  const observed = hostKeys.data?.items.find((k) => k.status === 'observed') ?? null;
  const added = (location.state as { added?: boolean } | null)?.added === true;
  const visibleKeys = (keys.data?.items ?? []).filter((k) => !k.removed_at);

  return (
    <Stack gap="md">
      <Group justify="space-between" align="flex-start">
        <Stack gap={4}>
          <Title order={1} style={WRAP}>
            {tg.name}
          </Title>
          <Text size="sm" style={WRAP}>
            {t('targets.address', { user: tg.username, host: tg.host, port: tg.port })}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
        <TargetStatusBadge status={tg.status} testId="target-status" />
      </Group>
      {added && (
        <Alert color="green" role="status">
          {t('targets.added')}
        </Alert>
      )}
      {tg.status === 'host_key_changed' && (
        <Alert color="red" role="alert" data-testid="host-key-changed">
          <Stack gap="xs">
            <Text size="sm">{t('targets.hostKeyChanged')}</Text>
            {admin && (
              <Button size="xs" color="red.9" w="fit-content" onClick={() => setRepinning(true)}>
                {t('hostKeys.review')}
              </Button>
            )}
          </Stack>
        </Alert>
      )}
      {tg.status === 'pending_host_key' && admin && observed && (
        <Card withBorder padding="md">
          <Stack gap="xs">
            <Title order={2} size="h3">
              {t('hostKeys.confirmTitle')}
            </Title>
            <HostKeyConfirm host={tg.host} hostKey={observed} busy={busy} onYes={() => void runJob(() => confirmHostKey(tg.id, observed.id, observed.fingerprint))} />
          </Stack>
        </Card>
      )}
      <Facts target={tg} />
      {canOperate && (
        <Group gap="sm">
          <Button variant="default" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void runJob(() => testTarget(tg.id))}>
            {t('targets.test')}
          </Button>
          <Button variant="default" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void runJob(() => discoverTarget(tg.id))}>
            {t('targets.discover')}
          </Button>
          {admin && (
            <Button variant="light" color="red.9" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setDeleting(true)}>
              {t('targets.delete')}
            </Button>
          )}
        </Group>
      )}
      {busy && (
        <Group gap="sm" role="status" aria-live="polite">
          <Loader size="sm" aria-hidden />
          <Text size="sm">{t('targets.working')}</Text>
        </Group>
      )}
      {done && (
        <Text size="sm" role="status">
          {t('targets.jobDone')}
        </Text>
      )}
      {error instanceof JobTimeoutError ? (
        <Alert color="yellow" role="status">
          {t('targets.stillWorking')}
        </Alert>
      ) : (
        <ErrorAlert error={error} />
      )}
      <JobErrorAlert error={jobError} />

      <Title order={2} size="h3">
        {t('targets.keysTitle')}
      </Title>
      <ErrorAlert error={keys.error} />
      {keys.isSuccess && visibleKeys.length === 0 && <Text c="gray.7">{t('targets.noKeys')}</Text>}
      {visibleKeys.length > 0 && (
        <Table.ScrollContainer minWidth={720}>
          <Table striped data-testid="target-keys">
            <Table.Thead>
              <Table.Tr>
                <Table.Th>{t('sshKeys.user')}</Table.Th>
                <Table.Th>{t('sshKeys.key')}</Table.Th>
                <Table.Th>{t('sshKeys.file')}</Table.Th>
                <Table.Th>{t('sshKeys.comment')}</Table.Th>
                <Table.Th>{t('sshKeys.actions')}</Table.Th>
              </Table.Tr>
            </Table.Thead>
            <Table.Tbody>
              {visibleKeys.map((k) => (
                <Table.Tr key={k.id}>
                  <Table.Td>{k.os_user}</Table.Td>
                  <Table.Td>
                    <Stack gap={2}>
                      <Text size="xs">{k.key_type}</Text>
                      <Code style={WRAP}>{k.fingerprint}</Code>
                      <KeyFlags location={k} />
                    </Stack>
                  </Table.Td>
                  <Table.Td>
                    <Code style={WRAP}>{k.file_path}</Code>
                  </Table.Td>
                  <Table.Td style={WRAP}>{k.comment}</Table.Td>
                  <Table.Td>
                    {canOperate && (
                      <Button size="xs" variant="light" color="red.9" onClick={() => setRemoving(k)} aria-label={t('sshKeys.removeNamed', { user: k.os_user })}>
                        {t('sshKeys.removeConfirm')}
                      </Button>
                    )}
                  </Table.Td>
                </Table.Tr>
              ))}
            </Table.Tbody>
          </Table>
        </Table.ScrollContainer>
      )}

      {repinning && (
        <RepinDialog
          target={tg}
          pinned={pinned}
          observed={observed}
          onClose={() => setRepinning(false)}
          onAccepted={(accepted) => {
            setRepinning(false);
            void runJob(() => Promise.resolve(accepted));
          }}
        />
      )}
      {deleting && (
        <DeleteTargetDialog
          target={tg}
          onClose={() => setDeleting(false)}
          onDeleted={() => {
            void refresh();
            navigate('/servers');
          }}
        />
      )}
      {removing && (
        <RemoveKeyDialog
          location={removing}
          onClose={() => setRemoving(null)}
          onDone={() => {
            setRemoving(null);
            void refresh();
          }}
        />
      )}
    </Stack>
  );
}

function Facts({ target }: { target: Target }) {
  const { t, i18n } = useTranslation();
  const f = target.facts;
  // unreadable_line is shown per line from facts.unreadable below, so the summary warning is skipped here.
  const warnings = f.warnings.filter((w) => w.code !== 'unreadable_line' && i18n.exists(`warnings.${w.code}`));
  return (
    <Stack gap={4}>
      {f.os.pretty_name && <Text size="sm">{t('targets.facts.os', { name: f.os.pretty_name })}</Text>}
      {f.helper_version && <Text size="sm">{t('targets.facts.helper', { version: f.helper_version })}</Text>}
      <Text size="sm">
        {target.last_discovery_at
          ? t('targets.facts.lastDiscovery', { time: formatDateTime(target.last_discovery_at, i18n.language) })
          : t('targets.facts.neverScanned')}
      </Text>
      {warnings.map((w) => (
        <Alert key={`${w.code}-${JSON.stringify(w.params)}`} color="yellow" style={WRAP}>
          {t(`warnings.${w.code}`, w.params)}
        </Alert>
      ))}
      {f.unreadable.map((u) => (
        <Alert key={`${u.file_path}-${u.line_no}`} color="yellow" style={WRAP}>
          {t('warnings.unreadable_line', { file_path: u.file_path, line_no: u.line_no })}
        </Alert>
      ))}
    </Stack>
  );
}

function RepinDialog({
  target,
  pinned,
  observed,
  onClose,
  onAccepted,
}: {
  target: Target;
  pinned: HostKey | null;
  observed: HostKey | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onAccepted: (accepted: JobAccepted) => void;
}) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { run } = useStepUp();
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<unknown>(null);

  const submit = async (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!observed) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      // hostkeys.repin needs a fresh step-up (§25.1): run asks for a code when the server says so.
      onAccepted(await run(() => repinHostKey(target.id, observed.id, observed.fingerprint, reason.trim())));
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err);
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <AppModal opened onClose={onClose} title={t('hostKeys.repinTitle')} size="lg">
      <form onSubmit={(e) => void submit(e)}>
        <Stack gap="sm">
          <Text size="sm">{t('hostKeys.repinHelp')}</Text>
          {pinned && (
            <>
              <Text size="sm" fw={600}>
                {t('hostKeys.oldFingerprint')}
              </Text>
              <Code block style={WRAP}>
                {pinned.fingerprint}
              </Code>
            </>
          )}
          {observed ? (
            <>
              <Text size="sm" fw={600}>
                {t('hostKeys.newFingerprint')}
              </Text>
              <Code block data-testid="repin-new-fingerprint" style={WRAP}>
                {observed.fingerprint}
              </Code>
              <Text size="sm" fw={600}>
                {t('hostKeys.commandLabel')}
              </Text>
              <Code block style={WRAP}>
                {observed.verify_command}
              </Code>
              <Textarea
                label={t('hostKeys.reason')}
                description={t('hostKeys.reasonHelp')}
                value={reason}
                onChange={(e) => setReason(e.currentTarget.value)}
                required
                minLength={10}
                maxLength={500}
                autosize
                minRows={2}
              />
            </>
          ) : (
            <Text size="sm">{t('hostKeys.noCandidate')}</Text>
          )}
          <ErrorAlert error={error} />
          <Group justify="flex-end">
            <Button variant="default" onClick={onClose}>
              {t('hostKeys.cancel')}
            </Button>
            {observed && (
              <Button type="submit" color="red.9" loading={busy} disabled={reason.trim().length < 10}>
                {t('hostKeys.repin')}
              </Button>
            )}
          </Group>
        </Stack>
      </form>
    </AppModal>
  );
}

function DeleteTargetDialog({ target, onClose, onDeleted }: { target: Target; onClose: () => void; onDeleted: () => void }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<unknown>(null);
  const confirm = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await deleteTarget(target.id);
      onDeleted();
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e);
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };
  return (
    <AppModal opened onClose={onClose} title={t('targets.deleteTitle')}>
      <Stack gap="sm">
        <Text size="sm">{t('targets.deleteHelp')}</Text>
        <ErrorAlert error={error} />
        <Group justify="flex-end">
          <Button variant="default" onClick={onClose}>
            {t('targets.cancel')}
          </Button>
          <Button color="red.9" loading={busy} onClick={() => void confirm()}>
            {t('targets.delete')}
          </Button>
        </Group>
      </Stack>
    </AppModal>
  );
}
```

The SSH key inventory screen (spec §26.5 "SSH key inventory screen with filters"): every key Alice found, once per key,
with search, server, user, finding and "show keys that are no longer found" filters and cursor paging; the key page
lists every place the key is used with links to the servers and the per-location remove dialog of Task 20. The setup
wizard gets step 7 of §18.5 ("Connect your servers": Alice's public key, the preparation commands and an optional
"Add a server now") between the license step and Finish, and the Playwright wizard helper learns that step so the Phase
1 and Phase 2 journeys keep working. The Audit log page gets English and Turkish labels for every Phase 3 audit action.

```tsx
import { screen, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { http, HttpResponse } from 'msw';
import { sessionFor, sessionHandlers, sshKeyFixture, targetFixture, targetWith } from '../test/fixtures';
import { renderRoute } from '../test/render';
import { server } from '../test/server';

const weak = sshKeyFixture({
  id: '0192b000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000k2',
  fingerprint: 'SHA256:weakWeakWeakWeakWeakWeakWeakWeakWeakWeakWeak0',
  key_type: 'ssh-rsa',
  bits: 1024,
  weak: true,
  comment: 'old@laptop',
  location_count: 1,
  target_count: 1,
});
const alice = sshKeyFixture({
  id: '0192b000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000k9',
  fingerprint: 'SHA256:aliceAliceAliceAliceAliceAliceAliceAlice00',
  comment: 'alice-platform',
  is_platform_key: true,
});
const db = targetWith({ id: '0192b000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000a2', name: 'db-01' });

// keysServer answers like the server: the first page has a cursor, the second does not; it records every query.
function keysServer(role: 'admin' | 'operator' | 'auditor' = 'auditor', lang = 'en') {
  const queries: URLSearchParams[] = [];
  server.use(
    ...sessionHandlers(sessionFor(role, lang)),
    http.get('/api/v1/targets', () => HttpResponse.json({ items: [targetFixture, db], next_cursor: null })),
    http.get('/api/v1/ssh-keys', ({ request }) => {
      const params = new URL(request.url).searchParams;
      queries.push(params);
      if (params.get('cursor') === 'page-2') return HttpResponse.json({ items: [alice], next_cursor: null });
      return HttpResponse.json({ items: [sshKeyFixture(), weak], next_cursor: 'page-2' });
    }),
  );
  return queries;
}

describe('SSHKeysPage', () => {
  beforeEach(() => localStorage.clear());

  it('lists every key once with its findings and pages with the cursor', async () => {
    const queries = keysServer();
    await renderRoute('/ssh-keys');
    expect(await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'SSH keys', level: 1 })).toBeInTheDocument();
    const table = await screen.findByTestId('ssh-keys-table');
    const row = within(table).getByText('deploy@laptop').closest('tr')!;
    expect(within(row).getByRole('link', { name: 'SHA256:deployDeployDeployDeployDeployDeployDeploy0' })).toHaveAttribute(
      'href',
      '/ssh-keys/0192b000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000k1',
    );
    expect(within(row).getByText('ssh-ed25519, 256 bits')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(within(table).getByText('old@laptop').closest('tr')!).getByText('Weak key')).toBeInTheDocument();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Show more' }));
    const aliceRow = (await within(table).findByText('alice-platform')).closest('tr')!;
    expect(within(aliceRow).getByText("Alice's key")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Show more' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(queries.at(-1)?.get('cursor')).toBe('page-2');
  });

  it('sends the filters to the server', async () => {
    const queries = keysServer();
    await renderRoute('/ssh-keys');
    await screen.findByTestId('ssh-keys-table');
    await userEvent.selectOptions(screen.getByLabelText('Server'), db.id);
    await waitFor(() => expect(queries.at(-1)?.get('target_id')).toBe(db.id));
    await userEvent.selectOptions(screen.getByLabelText('Finding'), 'weak');
    await waitFor(() => expect(queries.at(-1)?.get('flag')).toBe('weak'));
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByLabelText('Show keys that are no longer found'));
    await waitFor(() => expect(queries.at(-1)?.get('missing')).toBe('true'));
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText('User'), 'deploy');
    await waitFor(() => expect(queries.at(-1)?.get('os_user')).toBe('deploy'));
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/^Search/), 'İzmir');
    // The search is debounced: the server sees the whole word once, not one query per letter.
    await waitFor(() => expect(queries.at(-1)?.get('q')).toBe('İzmir'));
    expect(queries.filter((q) => q.get('q') === 'İ')).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('says when nothing matches', async () => {
    keysServer();
    server.use(http.get('/api/v1/ssh-keys', () => HttpResponse.json({ items: [], next_cursor: null })));
    await renderRoute('/ssh-keys');
    expect(await screen.findByText('No SSH keys match these filters.')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('is shown in Turkish', async () => {
    keysServer('operator', 'tr');
    await renderRoute('/ssh-keys', { languages: ['tr-TR'] });
    expect(await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'SSH anahtarları', level: 1 })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(await screen.findByText('ssh-ed25519, 256 bit')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText('Artık bulunmayan anahtarları göster')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});
```

```tsx
import { screen, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { http, HttpResponse } from 'msw';
import type { SSHKey } from '../api/types';
import {
  aliceKeyLocation,
  errorResponse,
  jobFixture,
  keyLocationFixture,
  sessionFor,
  sessionHandlers,
  sshKeyFixture,
} from '../test/fixtures';
import { renderRoute } from '../test/render';
import { server } from '../test/server';

const onDb = keyLocationFixture({
  id: '0192b000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000l5',
  target_id: '0192b000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000a2',
  target_name: 'db-01',
  line_no: 4,
  missing_since: '2026-10-02T08:00:00Z',
});
const key: SSHKey = { ...sshKeyFixture(), locations: [keyLocationFixture(), onDb] };

function onKey(role: 'admin' | 'operator' | 'auditor', k: SSHKey = key) {
  server.use(...sessionHandlers(sessionFor(role)), http.get('/api/v1/ssh-keys/:id', () => HttpResponse.json(k)));
}

describe('SSHKeyDetailPage', () => {
  beforeEach(() => localStorage.clear());

  it('shows the key and every place it is used', async () => {
    onKey('auditor');
    await renderRoute(`/ssh-keys/${key.id}`);
    expect(await screen.findByRole('heading', { name: 'SSH key', level: 1 })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText(key.public_key)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Where this key is used' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    const table = screen.getByTestId('key-locations');
    const web = within(table).getByRole('link', { name: 'web-01' });
    expect(web).toHaveAttribute('href', `/servers/${keyLocationFixture().target_id}`);
    const dbRow = within(table).getByRole('link', { name: 'db-01' }).closest('tr')!;
    expect(within(dbRow).getByText('No longer found')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(dbRow).getByText('4')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /^Remove key from/ })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('refuses to remove Alice’s own key', async () => {
    onKey('admin', { ...sshKeyFixture({ is_platform_key: true, comment: 'alice-platform' }), locations: [aliceKeyLocation] });
    server.use(http.post('/api/v1/ssh-keys/locations/:id/actions/remove', () => errorResponse(409, 'ALC-KEY-0001', 'sshkey.own_key_protected')));
    await renderRoute(`/ssh-keys/${key.id}`);
    await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Remove key from alice-svc' }));
    const dialog = await screen.findByRole('dialog', { name: 'Remove this key from the server?' });
    await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'Remove key' }));
    expect(await within(dialog).findByText('Alice needs this key to connect to this server and will not remove it.')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('asks an administrator before removing the last key of root', async () => {
    const rootLoc = keyLocationFixture({ os_user: 'root', file_path: '/root/.ssh/authorized_keys' });
    onKey('admin', { ...key, locations: [rootLoc] });
    const bodies: unknown[] = [];
    server.use(
      http.post('/api/v1/ssh-keys/locations/:id/actions/remove', async ({ request }) => {
        const body = (await request.json()) as { confirm_last_root_key: boolean };
        bodies.push(body);
        return body.confirm_last_root_key
          ? HttpResponse.json({ job_id: 'job-r', status_url: '/api/v1/jobs/job-r' }, { status: 202 })
          : errorResponse(409, 'ALC-KEY-0002', 'sshkey.last_root_key');
      }),
      http.get('/api/v1/jobs/:id', () => HttpResponse.json(jobFixture({ id: 'job-r', type: 'sshkey.remove' }))),
    );
    await renderRoute(`/ssh-keys/${key.id}`);
    await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole('button', { name: 'Remove key from root' }));
    const dialog = await screen.findByRole('dialog', { name: 'Remove this key from the server?' });
    await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'Remove key' }));
    const confirm = await within(dialog).findByLabelText('This is the last key of the root account. Remove it anyway.');
    expect(within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'Remove key' })).toBeDisabled();
    await userEvent.click(confirm);
    await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole('button', { name: 'Remove key' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog', { name: 'Remove this key from the server?' })).not.toBeInTheDocument());
    expect(bodies).toEqual([{ confirm_last_root_key: false }, { confirm_last_root_key: true }]);
  });
});
```
